referenceShapes.label: Direct Svelte consumer reference app
onboardingSteps: Read the package and extension-SDK baselines before wiring imports.
Start from tokens, then components, and add icon packages only where they clarify the UI contract.
Keep app-specific workflows, persistence, and orchestration outside the shared packages.
blockers: This is a composition baseline, not a generated app template or proof of GPUI parity.

referenceShapes.label: Underlay bridge-mediated reference app
referenceShapes.audience: teams preserving an existing app-local API while adopting Poodle internally
onboardingSteps: Adopt Poodle only behind bridge-owned aliases and wrappers.
Keep app imports Poodle-agnostic and route all compatibility translation through the bridge.
Treat wrapper translation, host integration, and rollout pacing as downstream-owned concerns.
blockers: Reference guidance exists, but real downstream wrapper and accessibility rollout evidence remains outside this repo.

referenceShapes.label: Workstation-oriented reference app
referenceShapes.audience: teams adopting generic shell and dock surfaces while keeping domain widgets downstream-owned
onboardingSteps: Use workstation shells as shared foundation rather than as a domain-specific widget kit.
Keep command registries, layout policy, and domain widgets app-owned.
Treat GPUI workstation parity as an explicit adoption blocker, not an implied capability.
blockers: This shape proves generic workstation foundation, not DAW-specific surface ownership or native parity.

referenceShapes.label: Public-facing example surface
referenceShapes.audience: evaluators and adopters learning the system before direct integration
onboardingSteps: Use the preview surface to inspect package ownership, contract ownership, and stateful examples.
Follow preview sections back to the owning contracts and package READMEs rather than copying shell-specific demo code.
Treat preview examples as discoverability and inspection aids, not as hidden public API templates.
blockers: The preview is still an internal docs harness, not a published versioned docs site or app starter.

onboardingLanes.label: Evaluate the system
nonGoals: Do not treat preview glue or section-specific example code as hidden package API.
Do not infer GPUI component readiness from browser examples alone.

onboardingLanes.label: Direct Svelte adoption
nonGoals: Do not bypass contracts with deep imports or ad hoc wrappers that redefine canonical meaning.
Do not import workstation shells unless the app actually needs them.

onboardingLanes.label: Bridge-mediated adoption
nonGoals: Do not expose Poodle package names directly in downstream app imports.
Do not widen bridge aliases without concrete downstream pressure.

onboardingLanes.label: Workstation foundation adoption
nonGoals: Do not mistake workstation foundation for a DAW or domain widget kit.
Do not claim native-runtime parity from Svelte workstation examples alone.

publicExampleExpectations: Examples must point back to owning packages and contracts.
Examples must show meaningful state or shell posture instead of only default specimens.
Examples may support evaluation and onboarding, but they must not silently become product templates.
